title: Canonical finite projections of completed constant realization
statement: With the residue data of [def-weil-pbc-completed-constant-residue-data] and completion scalar map phi fixed by its evaluations, every completion module N has a canonical A-linear projection from its sheaf scalar extension to constant(N/I^(n+1)N). Its value on r tensor x is projected(r) times the constant residue of x. If a constant A-section and a completed scalar have the same n-th residue, their products have the same image under this projection. These constructions require no finiteness of N.

source.place: Tag 03EK and Tags 093J--093M; quotient scalar actions, sheafified scalar extension, and the explicit tensor-to-limit map

proof.text: Use the evaluation-semilinear residue map from the residue-data node and its sheafified constant-module map. The sheaf scalar-extension adjunction gives a map to the quotient-ring module, restricted along the ring projection. The identity of the underlying constant additive quotient sheaves is A-linear and invertible, so gives the required target over constant A.

The tensor adjunction and constant-generator formula give the projection on pure tensors. Completed-scalar linearity of scalar extension, together with the finite constant-quotient scalar formula, gives the second identity whenever the two scalar residues are equal.

def completedConstantProjection (X : Scheme.{u})
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (φ : adicLisseConstantRing X (AdicCompletion I A) ⟶ adicLisseCompletedRing X I)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, φ ≫ limit.π (adicLisseRingSystem X I) (op n) =
      (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (AdicCompletion.evalₐ I (n + 1)).toRingHom))
    (N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion I A)) (n : ℕ)
